value.description:
Wayfair believes everyone should live in a home they love. Through technology and innovation, we make it possible for shoppers to quickly and easily find exactly what they want from a selection of more than 14 million items across home furnishings, décor, home improvement, housewares, and more. Partnering with Product, Experience Design, Analytics, and business leaders across Wayfair, our Native App Engineering teams contribute to an award-winning mobile experience that makes shopping for your home delightful and engaging. iOS and Android engineers leverage the full capabilities of mobile devices and their SDKs. For example, our apps take advantage of augmented reality, computer vision-assisted product search using the device’s camera, and machine learning to create personalized experiences and improve the speed of the app.

The App Shop team charter is to empower customers across the entire shopping journey to explore detailed information on the products that support their feeling of home. The ideal candidate has experience in native Android development, and a proven track record of delivering high quality features efficiently. This person will leverage their breadth of knowledge to deliver features for Wayfair shoppers to make their shopping experience frictionless and delightful.

What You'll Do

Contribute to in-depth mobile projects surrounding middle-funnel functionality such as browsing and exploring product details, including architecting and developing new features, application maintenance and refactoring, and increased performance and automation.

Review code and provide guidance for other developers participating in our release approval process.

Being passionate about test coverage and quality engineering are paramount.

Use data and metrics to collaboratively drive impactful changes.

Frequently interface and interact with quality, UX, back-end/API, product, analytics, and other teams.

Though primarily focused on Android, collaborate with iOS and full-stack teams to ensure solutions are robust and aligned.

Lead by example; share knowledge, experience, and best practices through mentoring, tech talks, and presentations.

What You'll Bring

At least 1+ years of professional Android development on publicly available apps.

A passion for writing clean, readable, and thoroughly tested code, and an eagerness to share your expertise with others.

A mastery of Android fundamentals, interacting with endpoints, debugging, and memory management.

Experience having architected or designed complex features with product managers or other stakeholders.

A deep understanding of architecture patterns such as MVI, MVP, MVVM, Clean/VIPER, etc., as well as async patterns.

A drive to learn about new libraries and technologies, stay on the cutting edge of the evolving mobile landscape and an eagerness to create experiences that will delight users.

A genuine belief that constructive and respectful code reviews are the bedrock of a healthy team.

Knowledge of Material Design, Android UI/UX development, and best practices

Experience with the following is nice to have:

Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and GraphQL

Ruby or similar scripting languages

Working cross-platform with iOS and/or Full-Stack

Assistance for Individuals with Disabilities
Wayfair is fully committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, including individuals with disabilities. As part of this commitment, Wayfair will make reasonable accommodations to the known physical or mental limitations of qualified individuals with disabilities, unless doing so would impose an undue hardship on business operations. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, please let us know by completing our Accomodations for Applicants form.

Need Technical Assistance?
For more information about applying for a career at wayfair, visit our FAQ page here.

About Wayfair Inc.
Wayfair is one of the world’s largest online destinations for the home. Whether you work in our global headquarters in Boston, or in our warehouses or offices throughout the world, we’re reinventing the way people shop for their homes. Through our commitment to industry-leading technology and creative problem-solving, we are confident that Wayfair will be home to the most rewarding work of your career. If you’re looking for rapid growth, constant learning, and dynamic challenges, then you’ll find that amazing career opportunities are knocking.

No matter who you are, Wayfair is a place you can call home. We’re a community of innovators, risk-takers, and trailblazers who celebrate our differences, and know that our unique perspectives make us stronger, smarter, and well-positioned for success. We value and rely on the collective voices of our employees, customers, community, and suppliers to help guide us as we build a better Wayfair – and world – for all. Every voice, every perspective matters. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Your personal data is processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice (https://www.wayfair.com/careers/privacy). If you have any questions or wish to exercise your rights under applicable privacy and data protection laws, please contact us at dataprotectionofficer@wayfair.com.

post.description: Collect every review of a Wayfair product (loop on next_cursor until it is null) or keep a copy current: poll with sort=newest and stop at the last review_id or date you already hold. Use the product SKU (W110562316) or a wayfair.com /pdp/ product URL.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page. Send it with the same product, sort and ratings.

page_size.description:
Reviews per call. The upstream accepted 2000; 500 keeps responses small.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 500; default 100.

product.description: Product SKU (e.g. W110562316) or a wayfair.com /pdp/ product URL; the SKU is the code at the end of the URL slug.

ratings.description: Only reviews with these star ratings (1-5). Default: all.

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Stops paging at the first review dated earlier (inclusive of this date), so a sync that stores its newest date never re-reads old pages. Requires sort=newest. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

sort.description:
newest is date descending (use it for incremental sync); relevance is Wayfair's default ordering; rating_high / rating_low order by stars; helpful orders by the site's helpfulness ranking.

Provider reference: allowed values ["newest", "relevance", "rating_high", "rating_low", "helpful"]; default "newest".

200.description:
Customer reviews for one Wayfair product, read from the storefront's own federation GraphQL endpoint (the same persisted query the product page's reviews widget uses). Pages to the last review with an opaque cursor (`next_cursor`, up to 500 reviews per call) and never needs a login. Sorts: newest, relevance, rating_high, rating_low, helpful. Optionally filter by star rating, and pass `since` with sort=newest to stop at a known date for incremental sync. Each review has its stable review_id, rating, text, display name, ISO date, verified flag, badge, purchased options and photo ids; the response carries the product's total review count, average rating and 1-5 star distribution. Wayfair exposes no review title and no helpful-vote counts, so neither is returned.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `average_rating` | number | Average star rating; null when the product has no reviews. |
| `count` | number | Reviews on this page. |
| `next_cursor` | string | Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page (or once `since` is reached). |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `page_size` | number |  |
| `product` | object |  |
| `rating_distribution` | object[] | Review count per star rating for the whole product (one entry per star level the source lists). |
| `ratings` | number[] | Star filter as applied; empty means all. |
| `reviews` | object[] |  |
| `since` | string |  |
| `sort` | string |  |
| `total` | number | Reviews matching the request as the source counts them: every review of the product, or only those with the requested `ratings` when a star filter is set. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

200.description:
Search Wayfair's open jobs by title keywords and by team, team category, country, state, location and job type ids (ids from list_filters). The upstream POST returns every match at once; this function pages it locally (`page`, `page_size`) and reports the total. Each job carries its ids (job_id `{system}-{eid}`, eid, internal id), title, team, category, location, job type, level, salary range and currency as stated, posting dates, the brief description (HTML and text) and the detail and apply URLs, plus facet counts for the whole match set.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | number | Jobs on this page. |
| `facets` | object | Counts per team, category, country, state, location and job type id over the whole match set. When nothing matches, Wayfair answers corpus-wide counts (probe of 2026-09-27); jobs without a US state are not counted under any state id. |
| `filters` | object |  |
| `jobs` | object[] |  |
| `keywords` | string | Keywords as sent (trimmed). |
| `next_page` | number | Page to request next; null when this page is the last. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `page` | number |  |
| `page_size` | number |  |
| `total` | number | Jobs matching upstream (the whole match set, before local paging). |
| `url` | string | The careers listing page with the same filters in its query string. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

value.description_html:
At Ocean Infinity, we're on a bold mission to subsea data using innovative technology.

Using cutting-edge robotics, autonomous technology and world-class software, we're transforming how complex operations are carried out at sea. Our uncrewed systems are making ocean exploration and operations safer, smarter and more sustainable, helping unlock the vast potential of our oceans while reducing environmental impact. 🌍

This isn't a vision for the future. It's happening right now.

As we continue to push the boundaries of innovation and redefine what's possible in the maritime industry, we're looking for exceptional talent to join our fast-growing team.

Ocean Infinity is looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to help build, operate & evolve the systems, tooling & infrastructure that support our software delivery & platform operations.

In this role you'll be taking ownership of key platform components & contribute to the foundations that enable engineering teams to build, deploy & operate services reliably at scale. You'll work on improving internal tooling, strengthening observability and operational practices & ensuring teams have the self-service capabilities required to confidently manage their services.

You'll report to the Core Engineering Lead & collaborate closely with the teams across the organization providing hands-on technical support, architectural input & practical solutions that strengthen the company's core engineering platform.
value.requirements_html:
What you will do! 🚀

  • Design and evolve core platform systems, Contribute to architecture & implementation strategy of cloud, Kubernetes, CI/CD & internal tooling foundations that support the operations across the organization
  • Drive High-impact Platform Improvements, Own & deliver enhancements across infrastructure, deployments & automation to improve reliability, scalability & performance
  • Build for resilience and efficiency, Develop platform capabilities that are secure, fault-tolerant & easy for product teams to adopt
  • Enhance developer productivity Create internal tools, services & workflows that aim to reduce friction & help engineers build, test and deploy faster & smoother
  • Strengthen observability and operations, Improve monitoring, logging & alerting to ensure visibility across environments and support fast, effective incident response
  • Solve complex technical challenges, Investigate & resolve issues across distributed systems, cloud services, networking & Kubernetes - & translate findings into measurable improvements
  • Collaborate across teams, Work closely with engineering and product teams to support new features, troubleshoot integration issues & ensure services run reliably on the platform
  • Evaluate and introduce new technologies, Stay current with cloud-native & DevOps ecosystems – bringing in tools & approaches that aim to improve delivery speed, reliability and developer experience
  • Promote platform standards and best practices, Help establish and reinforce patterns that lead to secure, scalable and well-operated services

What we look for!🔍

  • You have a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience
  • You bring in 5+ years of experience working in Platform Engineering, SRE, DevOps or infrastructure-focused software development
  • You have a strong experience with Cloud environments (Azure preferred) and understand the fundamentals of cloud networking, identity, compute & storage
  • You have deep, hands-on experience operating Kubernetes in production – including deployments, troubleshooting, networking & day-to-day operations
  • You are comfortable running & operating containerized services at scale
  • You work confidently with infrastructure-as-code to automate deployments environments and operational workflows
  • You have experience owning, building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, internal tooling or automation that supports development operations
  • You’re comfortable troubleshooting issues across distributed systems, networking, containers and cloud services
  • You have a strong understanding of monitoring, logging, tracing and alerting and appreciate the value that a strong observability setup brings to an organization

Nice to have! ✨

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tooling such as Terraform as familiarity with modern Kubernetes configuration approaches – operators, GitOps controllers, or similar
  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes internals, cluster lifecycle & multi-cluster patterns
  • Experience operating & supporting platforms across Azure and on-prem environments, including practical experience with Windows Servers & Linux systems
  • Solid understanding of distributed system concepts, including service networking, messaging patterns & event-driven designs
  • Good grasp of software architecture fundamentals such as CQRS, domain-driven principles & how backend services interact with modern cloud-native environments
  • Understanding of structured observability concepts – metrics, traces, logs – even if not specialized in any single stack

value.description_html:
🌍 Redefining how people live.

At Blueground, we believe that when your base is reliable, the world opens up. That’s why we’re building the world’s leading platform for living.

Every year, 350 million people move between cities—yet today’s housing options haven’t caught up with the needs of this modern, mobile generation. Blueground was built to change that.

With 40,000+ homes across the globe, available for stays from a few days to a year or more, we’re just getting started. We’re on an exponential growth path to redefine living and create an entirely new category. Our edge? Powerful proprietary tech, operational excellence, and a team that executes with speed and discipline.

 Our culture is grounded in five principles:

  • Guests First – Every decision starts with their experience.
  • Move Fast – We value speed, momentum, and action.
  • Dive In – The magic is always in the details, and we go deep.
  • Embrace Change – Change isn’t a disruption; it’s how we grow.
  • Keep It Honest – Transparency accelerates progress—and strengthens relationships.

If you’re ready to do the best work of your life and help reshape how the world lives, we’d love to meet you.

The Role

We’re looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Pit Stop Lead/Maintenance Technician to join our fast-growing team in Athens. This field-based role is ideal for someone who thrives on solving problems, leading by example, and ensuring every property meets the highest standards of quality and guest satisfaction.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead Property Turnovers: Oversee the full apartment preparation process—from coordinating housekeeping and maintenance teams to conducting detailed inspections before guest check-ins.
  • Own Onsite Readiness: Assemble furniture, troubleshoot WiFi and tech setups, and carry out small repairs to ensure every apartment meets our standards before move-in.
  • Field Coordination & Team Supervision: Act as the go-to person in the field, managing relationships with external vendors, housekeeping staff, and building personnel to ensure seamless operations.
  • Perform Quality Control: Conduct thorough property inspections using mobile checklists, flag issues, and ensure that every space meets our cleanliness, functionality, and design expectations.
  • Hands-On Support: Step in to help with urgent needs—whether that’s swapping out furniture, fixing appliances, delivering essentials, or solving guest lockouts.
  • Drive Efficiency: Manage and maintain our corporate vans and inventory stock, ensuring supplies and tools are always available and organized.
value.requirements_html:
• 2–3 years of experience in a supervisory or team lead role—ideally in field ops, facilities, hospitality, or housekeeping
  • Comfortable performing basic handyman tasks and minor repairs
  • Physically capable of lifting 10+ kilos and being active for most of the workday
  • Tech-savvy—familiar with tools like Slack, G Suite, and mobile apps

value.description_html:
Cognizant (NASDAQ: CTSH) is a leading provider of information technology, consulting, and business process outsourcing services, dedicated to helping the world's leading companies build stronger businesses. Headquartered in Teaneck, New Jersey (U.S.). Cognizant is a member of the NASDAQ-100, the S&P 500, the Forbes Global 1000, and the Fortune 500 and we are among the top performing and fastest growing companies in the world.

The Technical Lead will drive design development and optimization of data centric solutions using SQL and Python in a hybrid work model. The role focuses on building secure scalable applications that support compliance related initiatives ensuring high quality standards robust performance and smooth collaboration across technology and business teams during day shifts with no travel requirements.

Responsibilities
  • Design and implement robust data solutions using SQL and Python that support critical business applications and ensure reliable performance in a hybrid work environment.
  • Coordinate end to end development activities across modules to ensure cohesive integration consistent coding practices and timely delivery of high quality features.
  • Guide junior engineers in applying best practices for SQL query design indexing strategies and Python coding standards to improve maintainability and system efficiency.
  • Analyze existing database and application workflows to identify performance bottlenecks and implement tuned SQL queries and optimized Python logic that enhance throughput.
  • Collaborate with product and compliance stakeholders to translate functional requirements into technical designs that support secure data handling and regulatory needs.
  • Oversee code review processes to ensure adherence to security guidelines data protection principles and efficient use of Azure SQL and Python frameworks.
  • Provide technical direction during solution design discussions by comparing alternative approaches and recommending architectures that balance scalability cost and operational simplicity.
  • Coordinate deployment plans for Azure based data components and Python services ensuring minimal disruption to day shift operations and reliable rollback strategies.
  • Document system architectures data models and integration points in clear technical artifacts that support knowledge sharing and future enhancements.
  • Engage with cross functional peers to ensure alignment between application logic database structures and compliance expectations reducing risk of audit findings.
  • Monitor production systems for data integrity issues performance anomalies and security alerts initiating remediation plans that protect business continuity.
  • Support incident investigation by tracing Azure SQL query behaviors and Python service logs identifying root causes and implementing durable fixes.
  • Evaluate and recommend improvements to development tools CI CD workflows and testing strategies that streamline delivery while maintaining strong quality controls.


Qualifications
  • Demonstrate advanced proficiency in Azure SQL including schema design complex querying performance tuning and management of cloud based data assets.
  • Apply strong Python programming skills to build modular testable and maintainable services that integrate smoothly with Azure based data platforms.
  • Utilize practical experience in compliance solutions or regulated environments to design systems that support audit readiness and data governance expectations.
  • Bring six to eight years of hands on technical experience in software development or data engineering roles with significant responsibility for solution delivery.
  • Communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical stakeholders to explain design decisions document requirements and support collaborative problem solving.
  • Exhibit familiarity with hybrid work practices and remote collaboration tools to maintain effective teamwork and project momentum across locations.

post.description: Start here to find job detail URLs and company slugs; pass page=next_page to continue. Filter by posting date (posted_within_days) and annual pay floor (min_annual_pay); title and city/state select the page. Distance, employment-type and location-type filters are not exposed.

location.description: US city and two-letter state, "City, ST" (e.g. "Austin, TX", "Los Angeles, CA"). Omit for the national title page.

min_annual_pay.description:
Annual pay floor in USD (the site's own pay filter, refine_by_salary=), e.g. 150000. The site matches on the pay range it shows for a card, its estimate included; read pay.source to tell stated from estimated pay.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 1000000.

page.description:
1-based page number; 20 cards per page. Use next_page from the previous call.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 25; default 1.

posted_within_days.description:
Only postings from the last N days (the site's own date filter, days=; its UI offers 1, 5, 10 and 30). With this or min_annual_pay set, the call uses ZipRecruiter's interactive search (/jobs-search) instead of the directory page.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 30.

title.description: Job title words, e.g. "software engineer" or "Registered Nurse". Slugified to ZipRecruiter's Title-Case-Hyphenated directory form.

200.description:
Search ZipRecruiter US jobs by title, optionally in a city ("Austin, TX"), one page of 20 job cards: listing key, jid, title, company, location, pay range (min/max, interval, annualized), employment and location types, benefits, posting/update times, snippet and the job detail URL. Without filters the cards come from the public /Jobs/<Title>/-in-<City>,<ST>[/<page>] directory page; with posted_within_days and/or min_annual_pay they come from the site's interactive search (/jobs-search?days=&refine_by_salary=) with those filters applied server-side. Sponsored placements are mixed in and page composition can vary between fetches.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `jobs` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `benefits` | string[] | e.g. medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid_time_off (BENEFIT_TYPE_NAME_* lowercased). Empty when the card lists none. |
| `company` | object |  |
| `company_url` | string | Absolute company jobs URL (/co/<slug>/Jobs). |
| `employment_types` | string[] | e.g. full_time, part_time, contractor (EMPLOYMENT_TYPE_NAME_* lowercased). |
| `is_new` | boolean | true when the card carries the site's NEW flag. |
| `jid` | string | Open seat id (16 hex chars); the jid= query parameter of the job detail URL. Stable across the listing's locations. |
| `listing_key` | string | ZipRecruiter listing key (22-char base64url), one per posting+location listing. |
| `location` | object |  |
| `location_types` | string[] | e.g. remote, in_person, hybrid (LOCATION_TYPE_NAME_* lowercased). |
| `pay` | object | Pay range as ZipRecruiter states it (parsed from the posting, provided by the employer, predicted or estimated); null when the page carries no visible pay. |
| `posted_at_utc` | string | RFC 3339 posting time as stated. |
| `short_description` | string | Card snippet with the site's <b> highlights removed and HTML entities decoded. |
| `title` | string |  |
| `updated_at` | string | RFC 3339 last update time as stated. |
| `url` | string | Absolute job detail URL (input for `job`). The URL the site states for the card, or, when the card omits it, one built from the jid, company, title and location. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
